categories.name: Area measurement (carpet, RERA, liveable)
categories.appliesTo: Every space in the flat: all rooms, bathrooms, balconies, utility, AC ledge, store, maid room
categories.tools: Laser distance meter, steel tape, tablet with floor plan, calculator
commonFindings: Total carpet area below the agreement (often balcony and utility)
shafts or ducts counted inside carpet area
internal walls thicker than the plan
super built-up loading higher than quoted

parameters.name: Reference data to collect
parameters.whatToCheck: Carpet area stated in the sale agreement, RERA registration, sanctioned plan and brochure. Super built-up (saleable) area, built-up area and loading %. Exclusive balcony, utility and terrace areas as stated. Room-wise dimension schedule if given. Rate per sq ft (for shortfall value).
parameters.tool: Agreement annexure, RERA project page, sanctioned plan, price sheet

parameters.name: Area definitions to apply
parameters.whatToCheck: RERA carpet area = net usable floor area including internal partition walls, excluding external walls, service shafts, exclusive balcony or verandah and exclusive open terrace (confirm the state rules wording). Usable floor area (liveable / visible carpet) = wall-to-wall room areas. Built-up, plinth and super built-up areas as defined in the agreement.
parameters.tool: RERA Act Sec 2(k), state RERA rules, agreement definitions

parameters.name: Spaces to measure
parameters.whatToCheck: Bedrooms, living, dining, drawing, kitchen, bathrooms and toilets, store, maid room and maid toilet, utility / wash area, passage and foyer, pooja niche, study nook, balconies, AC unit area, sunken areas, planters, niches and recesses.

parameters.name: Additions and deductions
parameters.whatToCheck: Column and beam projections, niches, recesses, bay windows, shaft cut-outs and wall offsets, each added or deducted according to the definition in use.

parameters.name: Wall thickness
parameters.whatToCheck: Internal and external wall thickness at door and window reveals, to build up carpet area from usable area.
parameters.tool: Steel tape, digital vernier caliper at reveals

parameters.name: Balcony, utility, terrace and AC ledge
parameters.whatToCheck: Measure each separately and confirm none is counted inside the carpet area unless the agreement says so.

parameters.name: Shafts and ducts
parameters.whatToCheck: Identify and measure plumbing, electrical and AC shafts; confirm they are excluded from carpet area.

categories.name: Plastering
categories.appliesTo: All internal walls, shaft faces, and external wall faces visible from balconies and windows
categories.tools: 2 m straight edge, spirit level, plumb bob, sounding hammer, side-light torch, crack gauge

parameters.name: Surface finish
parameters.whatToCheck: Smoothness, undulation, waviness, trowel and ripple marks, uneven patches.

parameters.name: Flatness and plumb
parameters.whatToCheck: Gap under a 2 m straight edge, wall plumb, plane of the wall across its height.
parameters.tool: 2 m straight edge with feeler gauge or wedge, plumb bob

parameters.name: Hollowness and debonding
parameters.whatToCheck: Drummy sound, bulging, loose plaster, especially near beam-column junctions and slab undersides.

parameters.name: Cracks
parameters.whatToCheck: Hairline, map and shrinkage cracks, cracks at masonry-RCC junction, diagonal cracks at openings, cracks along chases and window corners.

parameters.name: Corners, edges and reveals
parameters.whatToCheck: Squareness and straightness of internal and external corners, chipped edges, door and window reveals and returns, wall-ceiling junction line.

parameters.name: Thickness and consistency
parameters.whatToCheck: Visible thickness at cut-outs and openings, over-thick patches, finishing coat quality.
parameters.tool: Depth gauge or caliper at cut-outs

parameters.name: Workmanship defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Pop-outs, lime bursting, patchwork, rough patches, plaster drips and splashes, uneven texture, blistering.

parameters.name: Moisture-linked defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Efflorescence, powdering, flaking and damp stains on plaster. (Source diagnosis in Category 4.)

parameters.name: Plaster around services
parameters.whatToCheck: Chases for electrical and plumbing refilled flush, mesh over chases, plaster around switch boxes and pipe sleeves.

categories.name: Ceilings
categories.appliesTo: All rooms including bathrooms, kitchen, balconies and utility
categories.tools: Laser level, torch, moisture meter, thermal camera, telescopic pole
commonFindings: fan hooks missing or not load-rated

parameters.name: Soffit finish
parameters.whatToCheck: Plaster, putty and paint finish, undulation, patchwork, tray lines, roller marks.
parameters.tool: Side-light torch, straight edge on pole

parameters.name: Cracks
parameters.whatToCheck: Shrinkage cracks, cracks along beams, at wall-ceiling junctions, diagonal and map cracks.

parameters.name: Stains and moisture
parameters.whatToCheck: Water stains, rust stains, yellowing, efflorescence, dampness beneath bathrooms, balconies and utility of the floor above, stains from AC drains.

parameters.name: Level and sag
parameters.whatToCheck: Soffit level between rooms, sag at mid-span, beam bottoms.

parameters.name: Embedded points and openings
parameters.whatToCheck: Light points, fan hooks or boxes (presence and strength), exposed conduit, sleeves, AC pipe sleeves, shaft openings, sprinkler and detector positions.

parameters.name: Services under or through the ceiling
parameters.whatToCheck: Exposed wiring, pipes, drain lines at ceiling level, insulation.

parameters.name: Bathroom and kitchen ceilings
parameters.whatToCheck: Suitable moisture-resistant finish, access panels for services if provided.

parameters.name: Junction finishing
parameters.whatToCheck: Wall-ceiling line straight, cornices, shadow gaps and covings.

categories.name: Dampness and waterproofing
categories.appliesTo: Wet areas (bathrooms, toilets, kitchen, utility, balconies), external walls and windows, shafts, ceilings, skirting zones
categories.tools: Moisture meter (pin and pinless), thermal camera, drain plugs and sealing clay, water, marker, spirit level or digital level, torch, water dropper
commonFindings: Standing water on bathroom and balcony floors
damp patches below upper-floor wet areas

parameters.name: Visual signs
parameters.whatToCheck: Stains, tide marks, efflorescence, paint blistering or peeling, bubbling plaster, fungus and mould, swollen wood or laminate, rust stains, musty odour, wet or sagging patches.

parameters.name: Moisture measurement
parameters.whatToCheck: Readings on a grid across walls, floors, skirting and ceilings, compared with a reference dry area, recorded with location and material type.

parameters.name: Moisture mapping and thermography
parameters.whatToCheck: Thermal imaging of walls, ceilings and floors to find cold or wet zones, confirmed with the meter; record time and conditions.

parameters.name: Marble test
parameters.whatToCheck: On marble floors and marble skirting: moisture readings against a dry reference area; dark, damp or wet-looking patches; rising-damp and water stains; white salt deposits; staining along wet-area walls and balcony doors; water-drop absorption test on an inconspicuous spot to check sealing and porosity; stains that return after cleaning.
parameters.tool: Moisture meter, water dropper, thermal camera, camera

parameters.name: Ponding test
parameters.whatToCheck: Plug drains and hold water in bathrooms, toilets, utility, kitchen wet zone, balconies and sunken slabs; mark water level; record duration (commonly 24 to 48 hours as per specification); check ceiling of the floor below for seepage. Needs builder consent and access below.
parameters.tool: Drain plugs, sealing clay, water, marker, depth gauge, torch

parameters.name: Floor slope toward drains
parameters.whatToCheck: Slope direction and gradient, water stagnation after a pour test, puddles at corners.
parameters.tool: Digital level or spirit level with wedge, water jug

parameters.name: Wall-floor junctions in wet areas
parameters.whatToCheck: Gaps, cracks, sealant continuity, waterproofing upstand height at walls.

parameters.name: Bathrooms and toilets
parameters.whatToCheck: Shower zone, wall behind shower and WC, shower curb, wall-floor corners, door threshold, pipe penetrations, drain surrounds, concealed cistern wall.

parameters.name: Kitchen and utility
parameters.whatToCheck: Sink wall, platform-wall joint, dado, floor drain, washing machine area.

parameters.name: Balcony and exterior-facing floors
parameters.whatToCheck: Slope, drain outlets, parapet-floor junction, door threshold, floor-wall joint.

parameters.name: External walls and openings
parameters.whatToCheck: Wall-window frame joints, sill slope, cracks, lintel tops, sunshades, seepage after rain or a spray test.

parameters.name: Pipe penetrations and shafts
parameters.whatToCheck: Sleeves sealed, pipe-slab junctions, shaft wall dampness, sunken slab areas, drain pockets.

parameters.name: AC condensate and drain lines
parameters.whatToCheck: Dripping or seepage at AC pipe sleeves and ledges.

parameters.name: Plumbing-related leakage signs
parameters.whatToCheck: Bubbling near plumbing, wet wall behind fixtures, meter movement (see 13.7).

parameters.name: Ceiling seepage from above
parameters.whatToCheck: Stains and active drips beneath upper-floor wet areas.

parameters.name: Waterproofing evidence
parameters.whatToCheck: Builder warranty, membrane type, ponding test report for the unit.

parameters.name: Timing and re-test
parameters.whatToCheck: Note whether the inspection is in dry or monsoon conditions; plan re-checks after rain where results are doubtful.

categories.name: Flooring
categories.appliesTo: All rooms with floor finish: bedrooms, living, dining, drawing, kitchen, store, maid room, passage, balconies, bathrooms (finish only)
categories.tools: Hollow-tile tapper or sounding rod, 2 m straight edge, laser level, feeler gauge, joint gauge, torch

parameters.name: Material and finish
parameters.whatToCheck: Type vs specification, shade and batch uniformity, pattern and vein matching, polish, edge finish.

parameters.name: Hollowness
parameters.whatToCheck: Tap every tile or slab on a grid; record hollow count per room, edge and corner hollows, and severity (minor vs full).

parameters.name: Surface damage
parameters.whatToCheck: Cracks, chips, scratches, stains, dents, edge damage, discolouration.

parameters.name: Level and flatness
parameters.whatToCheck: Floor level across the room and gap under a 2 m straight edge. (Water slope in wet areas: 4.6.)
parameters.tool: Laser level, 2 m straight edge, feeler gauge

parameters.name: Joints and grouting
parameters.whatToCheck: Joint width consistency, alignment, grout fill, gaps, colour match, hairline cracks, sealed movement joints.

parameters.name: Pattern and alignment
parameters.whatToCheck: Straight lines, cut tiles at edges and doors, symmetry, vein continuity, cuts around fixtures and drains.

parameters.name: Edges and transitions
parameters.whatToCheck: Threshold strips, level change between rooms and materials, door threshold finish, edge sealing.

parameters.name: Skirting
parameters.whatToCheck: Alignment, gap to wall, hollowness, cracks, corner mitres, height, joints, fixing.

parameters.name: Anti-skid flooring (wet areas and balconies)
parameters.whatToCheck: Finish suitable for wet use and matches specification.

parameters.name: Marble and stone specifics
parameters.whatToCheck: Polish, stains, pitting, natural fissures, resin filling, shade and vein mismatch.

parameters.name: Floor around fixtures and cut-outs
parameters.whatToCheck: Finish around floor traps, drains, manholes and door frames.

parameters.name: Expansion joints
parameters.whatToCheck: Presence at required locations and filling.

categories.name: Wall tiling
categories.appliesTo: Bathrooms, toilets, kitchen dado and backsplash, utility, balcony wall tiles
categories.tools: Hollow-tile tapper, spirit level, laser line, straight edge, joint gauge, torch
commonFindings: Grouting gaps between wall tiles and between wall and floor tiles

parameters.name: Tile material and specification
parameters.whatToCheck: Type, size, thickness, shade and batch consistency, finish vs specification or sample.

parameters.name: Hollowness and debonding
parameters.whatToCheck: Tap every tile; record hollow tiles and loose edges.

parameters.name: Alignment
parameters.whatToCheck: Joint lines straight, plumb and level, continuous across walls, pattern alignment.
parameters.tool: Laser line, spirit level, straight edge

parameters.name: Joints and grouting
parameters.whatToCheck: Joint width consistency, grout fill, gaps, colour, hairline cracks, grout haze.

parameters.name: Surface defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Chips, cracks, scratches, glaze defects, pin-holes, warping, colour variation.

parameters.name: Flatness and lippage
parameters.whatToCheck: Tile-to-tile lippage and plane of the tiled wall.

parameters.name: Cuts and terminations
parameters.whatToCheck: Cuts around fixtures, pipes, switchboards and niches; neat edges; edge trims; internal and external corners; top edge finish at dado height.

parameters.name: Corners and junctions
parameters.whatToCheck: Wall-wall corners, wall-floor joint sealant, wall-countertop joints, movement joints.

parameters.name: Kitchen backsplash and wet zones
parameters.whatToCheck: Coverage behind sink and hob, sealing around fixtures.

parameters.name: Access and fixture areas
parameters.whatToCheck: Tiles around concealed valves, cut-outs and access panels.

categories.name: Stonework
categories.appliesTo: Kitchen, washrooms and balconies, where stonework is provided (one set of checks per room)
categories.tools: Steel tape, spirit level, tapping rod, caliper, torch
commonFindings: grouting gaps between stone and wall tiles

parameters.name: Platform material and thickness
parameters.whatToCheck: Granite, marble or quartz type, thickness, colour and pattern, edge profile against the specification.

parameters.name: Platform surface defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Scratches, chips, dents, stains, pits, resin-filled cracks, cracks, polish lines, shade variation between slabs.

parameters.name: Platform seams and joints
parameters.whatToCheck: Open or cracked seams, seam width, level difference at the seam, colour fill, missing sealing.

parameters.name: Platform edges and corners
parameters.whatToCheck: Chipped edges, rough or unpolished edges, sharp corners, uneven overhang, wrong edge profile.

parameters.name: Platform level and slope
parameters.whatToCheck: Platform out of level, water pooling, slope away from the sink.

parameters.name: Platform fixing and support
parameters.whatToCheck: Hollowness below the stone, loose or missing brackets, unsupported cantilever, loose wall fixing, movement when pressed.

parameters.name: Sink and hob cut-outs
parameters.whatToCheck: Wrong size or position, rough or chipped cut-out edges, corner cracks, overcut gaps.

parameters.name: Platform-wall joint and backsplash
parameters.whatToCheck: Gap behind the platform, sealant missing or uneven, gaps between stone and wall tiles.

parameters.name: Kitchen window sill
parameters.whatToCheck: Cracks, hollowness, wrong slope, missing drip groove, chipped edges, stains.

parameters.name: Counter or vanity top
parameters.whatToCheck: Material and thickness against the specification; scratches, chips, dents, stains, cracks, edge defects, seam gaps.

parameters.name: Counter cut-out and fixing
parameters.whatToCheck: Basin cut-out size and finish, corner cracks, hollowness below the top, loose or unsupported top, gap to the wall, missing sealant.

parameters.name: Door threshold or curb
parameters.whatToCheck: Wrong height, out of level, no slope to the wet side, hollowness, cracks, chipped edges, loose threshold, gaps with tiles, no water stopper between wet and dry zones.
parameters.tool: Spirit level, steel rule, tapping rod

parameters.name: Shower curb or partition stone (if provided)
parameters.whatToCheck: Wrong height or slope, cracks, chips, hollowness, unsealed joints with wall and floor, water spreading outside the shower zone.

parameters.name: Window sill
parameters.whatToCheck: Cracks, hollowness, wrong slope, missing drip groove, chipped edges, stains, gaps at the frame.

parameters.name: Niche or shelf stone
parameters.whatToCheck: No slope to drain, cracks, chips, loose shelf, rough edges.

parameters.name: Door threshold or sill
parameters.whatToCheck: Wrong height against the floor, no outward slope, hollowness, cracks, chipped edge, gap at the door frame, water entry at the threshold.
parameters.tool: Spirit level, tapping rod, water pour

parameters.name: Parapet coping or top stone (if provided)
parameters.whatToCheck: Out of level, wrong slope, open joints, cracks, loose or hollow pieces, weak fixing, no drip edge.

parameters.name: Window sill and ledges
parameters.whatToCheck: Cracks, hollowness, wrong slope, missing drip groove, chipped edges.

parameters.name: Surface and edge defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Scratches, chips, stains, pits, loss of polish, weather discolouration, edge damage.

categories.name: Painting and polishing
categories.appliesTo: All walls and ceilings, metalwork, doors, door frames and other wooden elements. Every defect below is logged on its own
categories.tools: Raking-light torch, coating thickness gauge (optional), camera
commonFindings: Paint stains on window glass (very frequent)
paint on switch plates and hardware

parameters.name: System and specification
parameters.whatToCheck: Putty coats, primer, emulsion type and brand, number of coats, finish (matt or sheen), texture.

parameters.name: Uneven or patchy coverage
parameters.whatToCheck: Missed spots, thin patches, putty or primer showing through, uneven sheen, lap marks.

parameters.name: Roller and brush marks
parameters.whatToCheck: Visible roller or brush strokes, streaks, orange-peel texture.

parameters.name: Runs, sags and drips
parameters.whatToCheck: Paint runs or sags on walls and ceilings, drip beads at edges, paint pooling in corners.

parameters.name: Peeling and flaking
parameters.whatToCheck: Film lifting or lost, peeling at corners, near wet areas and over putty.

parameters.name: Blistering and bubbling
parameters.whatToCheck: Blisters or bubbles in the film from trapped moisture or poor adhesion, pop marks. (Moisture source: Category 4.)

parameters.name: Cracking and crazing
parameters.whatToCheck: Hairline cracks or crazing in the film, filled cracks showing through the paint.

parameters.name: Chalking and powdering
parameters.whatToCheck: Powdery residue when rubbed, loose or dusty film.

parameters.name: Stains and discolouration
parameters.whatToCheck: Water, rust and yellow stains, efflorescence marks, mould or fungus, marker or smoke marks.

parameters.name: Dust, grit and pinholes
parameters.whatToCheck: Dust or grit stuck in the film, pinholes, pimples, brush hairs.

parameters.name: Visible touch-ups and patches
parameters.whatToCheck: Patch outlines, different sheen or shade at repairs, repainted spots that show in daylight.

parameters.name: Shade and colour mismatch
parameters.whatToCheck: Shade different from the approved card; difference between walls, rooms, coats or against the ceiling; fading.

parameters.name: Cut-in and edge lines
parameters.whatToCheck: Wavy or untidy lines at ceiling, skirting, frames, switch plates and tile edges; paint bleeding under tape lines.

parameters.name: Paint on other surfaces
parameters.whatToCheck: Spills and splashes on glass (very frequent), window frames, tiles, stone, switch plates, hardware, floors and sanitaryware.

parameters.name: Dry film thickness (optional)
parameters.whatToCheck: Measured film thickness on painted surfaces.

parameters.name: Wet-area paint
parameters.whatToCheck: Moisture-resistant paint where specified.

parameters.name: Metalwork paint
parameters.whatToCheck: Rust-protection coat missing, uneven enamel or powder coat, runs, chips, rust spots through the paint, paint on glass and fixings.

parameters.name: Polish system and specification
parameters.whatToCheck: Type (PU, melamine, lacquer or other), number of coats, finish (matt, semi-gloss or gloss) against the specification or approved sample.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Polish coverage and uniformity
parameters.whatToCheck: Patchy or blotchy polish, missed areas, uneven sheen, dull or glossy patches.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Brush marks and streaks
parameters.whatToCheck: Visible brush strokes, streaks, lap marks, marks against the grain.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Runs, drips and sags
parameters.whatToCheck: Thick polish runs, drip beads at edges and mouldings, pooling in panel corners.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Bubbles, pinholes and orange peel
parameters.whatToCheck: Air bubbles, pinholes, rough or orange-peel texture.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Grain and surface defects
parameters.whatToCheck: Raised grain, rough or unsanded surface, sanding scratches, visible filler patches, dust or fibres trapped in the polish.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Shade and colour mismatch
parameters.whatToCheck: Shutter against frame, door against door, one face against the other, or different from the approved sample.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Edges and hidden faces
parameters.whatToCheck: Unpolished or poorly polished top, bottom, lock-side and hinge-side edges, back of the door, frame returns and rebates.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Polish damage and stains
parameters.whatToCheck: Rubbed-through spots, burn or heat marks, water rings, stains, discolouration.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Tacky or uncured polish
parameters.whatToCheck: Sticky or soft film, finger marks, dust sticking to the surface, strong odour.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

parameters.name: Polish on hardware, glass and adjacent surfaces
parameters.whatToCheck: Polish splashes on hinges, locks, handles, glass, walls, tiles and floors.
parameters.section: Polishing (doors, frames and other wooden elements)

categories.name: Doors
categories.appliesTo: Main door and all internal swing doors (bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, store, maid room, utility). Glazed sliding and balcony doors are under Category 13
categories.tools: Feeler gauge, spirit level, plumb bob, torch, steel tape
commonFindings: cracks on beading and door frames

parameters.name: Main door
parameters.whatToCheck: Material, thickness, size, finish; shutter condition; alignment; frame fixing; gap uniformity; weather seal; peephole; closer, chain, latch and number plate if provided.

parameters.name: Internal door shutters
parameters.whatToCheck: Flush or panel, edges, laminate, veneer or paint, swelling, warping, edge damage, delamination.

parameters.name: Door frames
parameters.whatToCheck: Plumb, level and square, fixing to the wall, gaps between frame and wall, cracks, edge damage, beading cracks, frame paint or polish.
parameters.tool: Plumb bob, spirit level, feeler gauge

parameters.name: Alignment and gaps
parameters.whatToCheck: Uniform gaps at top, sides and bottom, rubbing, binding, sag, clearance above floor, closing without lifting, drifting open on its own.

parameters.name: Hinges
parameters.whatToCheck: Number, type, screws, smooth operation, squeaking.

parameters.name: Locks, handles and latches
parameters.whatToCheck: Type, function, latch and strike plate alignment, loose locksets and handles, key sets and master key.

parameters.name: Stoppers, tower bolts, aldrops, chain
parameters.whatToCheck: Fixing and smooth function; stopper buttons fixed.

parameters.name: Play after closing
parameters.whatToCheck: Rattling or slack in a closed shutter.

parameters.name: Bathroom and utility doors
parameters.whatToCheck: Water-resistant material, sealed bottom edge, privacy latch, louvres or vent if provided.

parameters.name: Door finish
parameters.whatToCheck: Scratches, dents, edge damage, delamination, swelling. (Polish and paint defects: Category 8.)

parameters.name: Frame treatment and rating
parameters.whatToCheck: Termite treatment evidence for wood frames; fire rating of main door if specified.

categories.name: Windows
categories.appliesTo: All windows, ventilators, and glazed balcony or sliding doors
categories.tools: Water hose or spray bottle, glass thickness gauge, feeler gauge, spirit level, torch

parameters.name: Frame and profile
parameters.whatToCheck: Material, brand, section thickness, finish, scratches, dents, corner joints, warping, plumb, level and square, fixing to wall.

parameters.name: Glass
parameters.whatToCheck: Type, thickness, scratches, chips, cracks, edge condition, stickers, glazing beads secure, glazing gasket, distortion.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.whatToCheck: Sliding, casement or tilt operation: smooth, no jamming, closes fully, stays open, rollers, tracks, friction stays.

parameters.name: Locks and hardware
parameters.whatToCheck: Handles, latches, multi-point locks, loose fittings, missing screw caps, rollers.

parameters.name: Gaps, play and alignment
parameters.whatToCheck: Shutter-to-frame gaps, play after closing, rattling, interlock overlap.

parameters.name: Gaskets and weather seals
parameters.whatToCheck: Fixed and continuous, no cuts, brush seal pile, gaskets not fixed.

parameters.name: Sealant and perimeter joints
parameters.whatToCheck: Continuity, width, adhesion, gaps between frame and wall, neatness, sill sealing, inside and outside.

parameters.name: Drainage channels and weep holes
parameters.whatToCheck: Present, not blocked by mortar or paint, sill slope.

parameters.name: Water leakage test
parameters.whatToCheck: Hose or spray on the exterior face; check inside sill and corners for water entry.

parameters.name: Ventilators and louvres
parameters.whatToCheck: Operation, fixing, insect screen, exhaust-fan opening.

parameters.name: Glazed balcony and sliding doors
parameters.whatToCheck: Track, rollers, locking, glass, gasket, threshold slope and water entry, handle height.

parameters.name: Window safety
parameters.whatToCheck: Toughened or laminated glass at low level, restrictors, opening limiters.

parameters.name: Air tightness (optional)
parameters.whatToCheck: Draught and whistle at closed windows.

categories.name: Metalwork (railings and grills)
categories.appliesTo: Balcony railings, window grills, AC ledge grills and louvres, safety grills, other metal fabrications inside the flat
categories.tools: Steel tape, spirit level, torch, caliper, SS test kit
commonFindings: Railing height below the plan or code

parameters.name: Balcony railings
parameters.whatToCheck: Material (SS grade, MS, glass, aluminium), thickness, finish, baluster spacing (child-safe gap), top handrail, base fixing.

parameters.name: Fixing strength
parameters.whatToCheck: Base plates, anchor bolts, post stability, glass clamps and spigots, handrail joints.

parameters.name: Welds and joints
parameters.whatToCheck: Weld quality, grinding, sharp edges, burrs, gaps, rust at joints.

parameters.name: Corrosion protection
parameters.whatToCheck: Paint, powder coat, galvanising or SS finish; rust spots, coating chips.

parameters.name: Window grills
parameters.whatToCheck: Fixing, spacing, finish, rust.

parameters.name: AC ledge grills and louvres
parameters.whatToCheck: Fixing, finish, spacing, maintenance access.

parameters.name: Other metal items
parameters.whatToCheck: Gates, access hatches and ladders if present.

parameters.name: Glass railings
parameters.whatToCheck: Toughened or laminated type, thickness, edge finish, gaps.

parameters.name: Gaps and clearances
parameters.whatToCheck: Gap between railing and slab or parapet, toe-board gap.

parameters.name: Alignment
parameters.whatToCheck: Straightness, level and plumb of railings.

categories.name: Electrical
categories.appliesTo: Distribution board, every room and wet area, balconies, AC points, low-voltage points
categories.tools: Multimeter, socket polarity tester, RCD tester, earth resistance tester, continuity tester, insulation resistance tester, clamp meter, load tester, thermal camera, torch, LAN cable tester, tone tracer
commonFindings: switch boxes out of alignment. TV or data points without cable

parameters.name: Distribution board (DB)
parameters.whatToCheck: Location and accessibility, enclosure, number of ways, circuit labelling, spare ways, neutral and earth bars, wiring neatness, knockouts and glands, cover, door fit, clearance.

parameters.name: MCB check
parameters.whatToCheck: MCB present on every circuit (lighting, power, AC, kitchen, geyser, washing machine); rating and type (curve) matching the load and wire gauge; ON and OFF action and latching; loose, hot or discoloured MCBs; MCB not tripping under overload; labelling not matching the circuit; no spare ways; doubtful or unmarked make.
parameters.tool: Multimeter, clamp meter, load tester, DB schedule

parameters.name: RCCB / ELCB check
parameters.whatToCheck: RCCB or ELCB rating and sensitivity, trip test with the test button and a tester, isolators, surge protection if provided, nuisance tripping, loose terminations.

parameters.name: Incoming supply and meter
parameters.whatToCheck: Meter installed, main switch, voltage, phase, polarity, sanctioned load, supply status.

parameters.name: Wiring
parameters.whatToCheck: Wire brand and gauge per circuit (lighting, power, AC, kitchen), colour coding, FRLS grade, concealed in conduit, joints only in junction boxes.
parameters.tool: Cable print, caliper or gauge, torch

parameters.name: Conduits and routing
parameters.whatToCheck: Concealed routing, conduit size, cover, exposed conduits, conduits through beams.

parameters.name: Switchboards and boxes
parameters.whatToCheck: Alignment (level and plumb), flush with wall, box depth, cover plates, loose boxes, cracks, height from floor.

parameters.name: Switchboard positioning
parameters.whatToCheck: Height from the floor and consistency between boards in the same room; distance from the door frame and door swing; position against the bed head, wardrobe, TV unit, modular kitchen and mirror; position against tile joints and cut tiles; sockets above the kitchen platform; distance from sink, shower, basin and hob; switch on the wrong side of the door; clash with niches, beams and false-ceiling lines; mismatch with the electrical layout drawing.
parameters.tool: Steel tape, laser level, electrical layout drawing

parameters.name: Switches and sockets
parameters.whatToCheck: Correct switching, loose or burnt fittings, sparking, polarity (L-N-E), earthing at socket, grip, shutters, 6A and 16A types.

parameters.name: Lighting and fan points
parameters.whatToCheck: Location, fan hook or box, regulators, IP-rated fittings in wet zones.

parameters.name: AC points
parameters.whatToCheck: Dedicated circuits, MCB rating, isolator or socket, wire gauge, indoor and outdoor locations.

parameters.name: Earthing
parameters.whatToCheck: Earth pit and continuity, earth wire sizes, DB earthing, metal boxes, geyser, AC and socket earthing, earth resistance, neutral-earth bonding.

parameters.name: Insulation resistance
parameters.whatToCheck: Insulation resistance of each circuit.

parameters.name: Voltage and phase

parameters.name: Load and trip test
parameters.whatToCheck: Circuit load test under real load, MCB trip behaviour, heating at connections, voltage under load.

parameters.name: Exposed wires and hot spots
parameters.whatToCheck: Loose terminations, burn marks, exposed conductors, hot spots.

parameters.name: TV points

parameters.name: Data and telephone points

parameters.name: Intercom and video door phone
parameters.whatToCheck: Indoor unit, door station, wiring, audio and video, door release.

parameters.name: Doorbell
parameters.whatToCheck: Switch, chime, function.

parameters.name: Security and CCTV provisions
parameters.whatToCheck: Conduits, cables and power outlets for CCTV, alarms or sensors.

parameters.name: Automation provisions
parameters.whatToCheck: Smart-home conduits or devices if provided.

parameters.name: Internet entry and spare conduits
parameters.whatToCheck: Fibre or cable entry to the flat, spare conduits, pull wires.

parameters.name: Routing and labelling
parameters.whatToCheck: Separation from power cables, labelling.

parameters.name: Digital lock and access control
parameters.whatToCheck: Function if provided.

parameters.name: Valves and isolation
parameters.whatToCheck: Main isolation valve, bathroom and kitchen isolation, angle cocks: accessible, smooth, no leaks.

parameters.name: Fixture connections
parameters.whatToCheck: Taps, mixers, showers, health faucet, flush tanks, concealed cisterns, flexible hoses: leaks, tightness, alignment, flow.

parameters.name: Leakage checks
parameters.whatToCheck: Joints at fixtures, wet marks under basins and behind WCs, main meter movement with all outlets closed.

categories.name: Drainage

parameters.name: Waste lines
parameters.whatToCheck: Slope, material, fixing.

parameters.name: Flow tests
parameters.whatToCheck: Pour or flush test: time to drain, backflow, gurgling, stagnation; check ceilings of the floor below if accessible.

parameters.whatToCheck: Smell test; smoke test where doubtful.

parameters.name: AC provisions per room

parameters.whatToCheck: Refrigerant copper tubing (liquid and gas lines) provided or sleeve-only as promised; tubing size and thickness; route from indoor to outdoor unit within the permitted run length; kinks, crushed or flattened sections, sharp bends; insulation missing, thin or broken; both ends capped and tagged; joints and brazing; pressure or nitrogen test record if done; control cable conduit; tubing damaged or cut during plastering or tiling.

parameters.name: AC condensate drain
parameters.whatToCheck: Slope and outlet; test with water.

parameters.name: Outdoor unit space
parameters.whatToCheck: Ledge dimensions, clearance, support, grill or louvre, maintenance access.

parameters.name: Multi-split or VRV provision
parameters.whatToCheck: If specified, pipe routes and outdoor unit space.

parameters.name: Exhaust fan provision
parameters.whatToCheck: Opening size and position, duct and termination to the outside, back-draught shutter, power point and switch, fan fitted if provided, blocked or capped openings, noise and vibration.

parameters.name: Kitchen chimney provision
parameters.whatToCheck: Duct route, power point, height, termination.

parameters.name: Ventilators
parameters.whatToCheck: Location, size, louvres.

parameters.name: Airflow check
parameters.whatToCheck: Exhaust performance and airflow direction.

parameters.name: Geyser location and mounting
parameters.whatToCheck: Wall strength and fixing provision, clearance and access for servicing, space for the capacity promised, distance from the shower and splash zone, headroom, missing bracket or blocking.

parameters.whatToCheck: Hot and cold inlet and outlet at the geyser position, isolation valve, non-return and safety valve provision, hot-water-grade pipe (CPVC or PPR), leaks at joints, inlet and outlet connected the wrong way, drain or overflow provision, hot line reaching the shower, basin or sink points.

parameters.name: Geyser electrical provision
parameters.whatToCheck: Dedicated socket or switch with indicator, MCB rating and wire gauge for the load, earthing, point height and distance from water, IP rating, switch location, loose or burnt terminals.

parameters.whatToCheck: Protective film on glass, frames and fixtures, floor protection: removed or still in place, and condition.

parameters.whatToCheck: Leftover materials, packaging, formwork bits, shaft debris.

parameters.whatToCheck: Number of key sets for main door, bedroom doors, bathrooms, store, balcony and windows; locks tagged; access cards, RFID tags and remotes.

parameters.name: Utility readiness

parameters.whatToCheck: No damaged or missing items.
